lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid, with spot diameter increasing and spatial density decreasing toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with larger circular blobs to form prominent grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, running parallel across the upper third of the visible flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated diagonal mark of high-intensity pixels cutting across the mid-flank, indicative of a significant cutaneous lesion or scar.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of smaller high-luminance blobs on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
